build_cosine_lr_schedule: build a cosine annealing learning rate schedule for training over a fixed number of epochs
create_cosine_schedule_with_warmup: create a cosine schedule with linear warmup from a start value to the base value
run_cosine_scheduler: run the cosine scheduler to generate an array of values across all training iterations
test_cosine_scheduler: test the cosine scheduler function with custom base value, final value, and epoch parameters
refactor_cosine_scheduler: refactor the cosine scheduler to support additional warmup strategies beyond linear interpolation
